text:
maria: quick design check — updated the Dataset table in Figma: https://figma.com/file/abc123 (screens + responsive notes). main questions: how to handle column density on small screens, visibility of row actions, and empty state copy. screenshots in the doc. :eyes:
jon: strong +1 for collapsing secondary columns into a detail drawer on mobile rather than horizontal scroll. feels more native and keeps consistent padding. downside: might be extra taps for power users.
lisa: if we go with a drawer, we need keyboard support: Enter/Space to open, focus moves to the first interactive thing in the drawer, and Esc closes + returns focus to the row. rows should have role=button and aria-expanded. also we need visible focus ring when using keyboard.
a11y-bot: automated scan: table header cells missing `scope="col"` in the markup sample. tag contrast check: `tag--info` bg #F2F6FF vs text #0B56D8 fails AA at 12px. recommend darker bg or darker text.
sam: spacing tokens note — current mock uses ad-hoc 8/20 units. can we standardize to `space-2` for row gap (8px) and `space-3` for table padding (12/16 depending on density)? keeps spacing consistent across Console. also consider a compact table variant for power users.
tyler: empty state copy feels too prescriptive: current "Upload a CSV to get started" assumes a file-first flow. suggestion: "No datasets yet. Add a dataset or try the sample dataset." CTA primary should be "Add dataset" (primary action) and secondary "Try sample". shorter, less techy.
jon: agree on CTA wording. also for compact variant consider a toggle in the table toolbar so we don't hide controls by default.
maria: decision proposal so we can move forward: 1) <=640px: collapse secondary columns into a right-side detail panel/drawer (not horizontal scroll). 2) Keyboard behaviour: rows are focusable (role=button), Enter/Space opens panel, Esc closes and returns focus to row — @lisa to own a11y spec. 3) Use `space-2`/`space-3` tokens. @sam to update token mapping in the figma token page. 4) Empty copy: "No datasets yet. Add a dataset or try the sample dataset." primary CTA "Add dataset", secondary "Try sample". 5) @maria to push prototype and @lisa to file a11y follow-ups (header scope + tag contrast). Any objections? :thumbsup:/:thumbsdown:
lisa: no objections — filing a11y ticket now with repro steps and suggested hex `#D7E4FF` for tag bg and `#0B3A8C` for text to meet AA. ticket #1234. :white_check_mark:
sam: on it — I'll update the token map and swap paddings in the figma components. will post PR link when ready.
tyler: will update empty state copy in copy doc and push to content repo.
maria: thanks all — I'll update the figma and prototype, ping when it's up. tagging for follow-ups: @sam @lisa @tyler. :sparkles:
